evidence: Own independent reduced Euler verification of five multipartite tuples
limitations: Assumes k≥2 all part sizes≥2. Not an equivariant splitting. Finite Euler checks alone could not prove homotopy; acyclic matching and cofibration provide the necessary structural argument.
correctness.rationale: Dominating complements meet at least two independent parts or equal one whole part. A vertex deletion and its link yield a cofibration quotient X0/L. Its relative faces split into one exceptional simplex plus disjoint branches B_j union nonempty proper subsets of A_j. In each branch, the contractible simplex-join Y_j modulo the boundary-plus-core Z_j is equivalent to S^{N-3} wedge S^{N-m_j-1}; endpoint B_j singleton is handled via S^0. The explicit matching pairs all link faces across v and inside each branch by adding w_j; a directed path cannot cycle between layers or branches, and an inserted w_j cannot be removed along a downward edge. Critical count gives k-1 top cells and one per part. Independent face enumeration/Euler checks for (2,2),(2,3),(2,2,2),(2,3,4),(3,3,3) agree with sphere wedge. The general conclusion uses the full combinatorial proof.
